## Checklist
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No real company code, customer data, personal emails, or real secrets in code, tests, or docs
- [ ] No code, prompts, or schemas copied from other PR-review tools
- [ ] `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, `mypy`, and `pytest` pass locally
- [ ] New detectors include a fixture and plain-language wording (title, why, check item)
